title: Penalty Kick
brief: Swipe up, left or right to kick the ball at a goal guarded by a patrolling keeper. Score 3 goals to win; 3 misses (keeper, post or off target) lose.

title: Mini Golf
brief: Swipe to putt the ball around a bumper, a fence and a moving windmill into the hole. Reaching the hole wins; 7 strokes lose.

title: Rally Pong
brief: Drag the paddle to rally a ball against a patrolling rival paddle. Get the ball past the rival 5 times to win; missing it 3 times loses.

title: Juggle Up
brief: Tap the falling ball to pop it back up and swipe to nudge it sideways. 20 touches win; dropping it 3 times loses.

title: Keeper Duty
brief: Drag the goalkeeper sideways to catch shots falling toward the goal. 12 saves win; 3 goals conceded loses.

title: Bounce Climb
brief: Drag a ball sideways to land on springs of growing power and climb to the basket at the top. The basket wins; falling on the spikes 3 times loses.

title: Ball Push
brief: Two sokoban-style levels: step a player with the pad and push the ball into the net past crates and rocks. Finishing level two wins.

title: Target Practice
brief: Swipe to bounce a ball off moving targets, where gold counts double. 5 hits win; running out of 8 balls loses.

title: Volley Wall
brief: Move the racket under a ball falling in gravity and volley it back over the net. 15 volleys win; letting it touch the sand 3 times loses.

title: Bowling Lane
brief: Swipe to roll the ball down a lane between gutters and knock down ten pins in three rolls. All ten win; pins left after the last roll lose.

title: Can Knock
brief: Tap a low, medium or high launch pad to throw a ball in an arc at six cans on a shelf. Knock all six to win; 6 throws are all you get.

title: Basket Shot
brief: Swipe up, right or down to throw ball arcs at a hoop that slides up and down beside a backboard. 5 baskets win; 4 misses lose.
